events.summary: In the Tales of the Ozolith, a shadow takes living form and devours a man.
events.quote: And then the shadow took living form, and the shadow devoured the man whole—body, mind, and soul.

events.summary: Narset struggles to meditate as dragonlings spiral around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.
events.quote: As Narset struggled to meditate, tiny dragonlings spiraled around her, conjuring thoughts of ancient clans.

events.summary: The behemoth Indath forms the lowlands with its final footsteps before vanishing into the sea, as told in the Tales of the Ozolith.
events.quote: These lowlands were formed thousands of years ago by the behemoth Indath—its final footsteps before vanishing into the sea.
